question: Given, x - (1)/(x) = 3 , find the value of x⁴ + (1)/(x⁴).
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ If x − 1/x = a, then x² + 1/x² = a² + 2 If x² + 1/x² = b, then x⁴ + 1/x⁴ = b² − 2 Here, a = 3 ⇒ b = 3² + 2 = 9 + 2 = 11 Now, x⁴ + 1/x⁴ = 11² − 2 = 121 − 2 = 119 **∴ The correct answer is 119.**
